Fabraix builds state-of-the-art AI red-teaming agents that continuously detect security vulnerabilities in customer-facing AI. Our product, Nyx, has already found vulnerabilities in agents at dozens of Fortune 500 companies. 

AI agents can change more often than teams can test them. A new model, prompt, tool, permission, or data source can change what an agent does, even when the application code stays the same. And AI is also increasing how much software companies produce and how often it changes. We built Nyx to automate the work required to red-team AI agents. It is multi modal by design and interacts with the target indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing malicious payloads in webpages, documents, files, messages, and tool outputs to test how an agent behaves under different conditions.

We're also the team behind ACE (Adversarial Cost to Exploit), a benchmark that measures AI security in terms of how much it costs attackers to break an AI system; providing a game-theoretic framework to understand how motivated a rational attacker would be in exploiting the system.

Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter.

We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. 

We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.

Tenor is a full-stack infrastructure for building and running AI-native businesses. We’re not just an agent framework, we manage the entire loop from how AI executes work to how every action, decision, and business outcome is captured and learned from. Owning the full stack lets companies deploy governed AI workflows, understand what actually drives results, and continuously improve how their business operates without building the infrastructure themselves.

Daqstra is the AI-native orchestration layer for physical R&D. It saves engineers in Aerospace, Energy and Robotics hundreds of man hours managing test infrastructure by connecting fragmented test hardware, bringing live and historical test data into one place, and by giving engineers an API to orchestrate their entire test setup. We enable teams to spend less time rebuilding test infrastructure and more time improving the hardware they test.

Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage for frontier tech: robotics, AI, software, and hardware companies. Founders describe what they build in plain English, and our licensed brokers place general liability, tech E&O, cyber, D&O, workers' comp, equipment, and other lines with insurers that cover AI and autonomy.

LATO is the agent-native research and simulation system that lets investors and companies test any thesis. Funds managing $500bn+ use LATO along with their portfolio companies.

We’re backed by leading funds including Y Combinator, Air Street Capital and Axiom Partners. Our angels include Paul Graham and co-founders of Vercel, ElevenLabs, Snowflake and Rogo. LATO was founded by a former private equity investor and an AI/ML engineer.

We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!

Neuron is crafting the world’s first purpose-built industrial controller for AI, replacing the antiquated PLCs running every machine and factory. We help customers from chemical processing to nuclear reactors compress controls projects from weeks to hours.

Arbital lets you trade perps, memes, stocks, and run market-making strategies from one place. In our first 7 months, 2,700 traders have traded $1.35B in volume through Arbital, and we're now doing $435M/month. 

We're building towards a social, mobile-first trading app that brings tokenized equities, crypto, and perps to everyone.

The technologies that define this century, including data centers, rockets, satellites, and robots, are built from complex metal parts. As these systems advance, the parts get harder to make. Past a certain complexity, casting and machining stop working, and the advanced methods that remain are slow, expensive, and hazardous.

Ultrasonium has invented a new manufacturing method to make these critical parts 15x faster and 75% cheaper than the methods they replace, in the U.S. and at scale. Solid metal feedstock goes in and a finished part safely comes out, controlled by a physical AI layer and novel control processes. 

The systems that matter most, in aerospace, energy, and compute, are demanding metal geometries that can't be machined or cast and are too expensive and slow to make with incumbent methods, at a moment when domestic manufacturing capacity is a national priority.

Our founding team has built and innovated some of the most complex engineering systems known to man: quantum computers, superconductors, nuclear reactors, and novel aerospace alloy processing methods.

With the government pushing to make title insurance optional on refinances, lenders are starting to take on title risk. Vestris gives every property a risk assessment, like a credit score for homes, so lenders know what they're lending against and homeowners know where their property stands.
subindustry: Real Estate and Construction -> Housing and Real Estate

description:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics. 
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it.
This lets Robot Labs train their robots using GPUs instead of relying on human collected manual data that is slow and expensive.
In unseen and hard to replicate environments, this is the only path to getting ANY training data.

Ekho predicts the wars, strikes and tariffs that break global shipping, and tells freight teams which shipments are exposed and what to do about them. Predicting escalation is what our team did for eight years before this - now we bring the same engine to logistics.

Isengard Industries is not another drone company.

We build sovereign production: the means for allied nations to make precision-strike and counter-drone systems by the thousand, on their own soil, at a fraction of what the primes charge.

We call it Weapons of Mass Production. The Arsenal of Democracy, rebuilt for the drone age.

More to come, and only where it helps. You know how to reach us.
Fixing health insurance by giving the buying power back to the individual.
Derivatives Exchange for Compute

TryNearby connects local businesses with creators who live nearby. Restaurants subscribe monthly and automatically get booked visits from local creators who film, edit, and post a review to the local algorithm. This creates a steady stream of content that compounds into discovery on TikTok, Instagram, and increasingly AI search. Over 100 restaurants and thousands of creators are on the platform across Southern California, with AI agents handling matching, booking, and every creator conversation.

Financial Datasets is an applied AI research lab building search and data infrastructure for agents, starting with financial markets.

We turn filings, company disclosures, and market data into structured, searchable information - helping agents find relevant facts, answer financial questions, and monitor markets in real time.

For 40 years, market data was built for people reading screens. We're rebuilding it for agents that research every company, all day, across the world.

Liquid Energy delivers the most scalable and cost effective inference. Our compute is hosted in our proprietary data center modules that we call NanoDC - the Nano Data Center. 

NanoDC is engineered to be rapidly deployable and scalable without traditional bottlenecks like power, permitting, and supply chains. Using NanoDC, Liquid Energy is able to provide the most efficient and sustainable way to scale compute to meet global AI demand.

We have 20 units and have spent the last year in building the supply chain and manufacturing, because of that we have an ability to manufacture 2 MW/month. Over the next year we will scale that up to 20MW per month.
Luca IQ is an API for deterministic tax calculation and an IRS Authorized e-filing engine - the foundation for accounting firms and fintechs building on tax.

We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week.

Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue.

Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. 

We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.

Bear (formerly Last Accounting Company) is a full-stack AI accounting firm. We sell the same service (bookkeeping, tax filings, etc.) as a traditional accounting firm, but underneath agents handle everything and a certified accountant signs off. Our service is faster, cheaper, and fully integrated, allowing our clients to focus on what matters, not accounting admin.

Executor.sh is an MCP gateway that allows you to sign in once to all of your integrations and use them with any client.

We enable you to connect your agents to anything (MCP, GraphQL, OpenAPI) so regardless of what you're trying to connect agents to you're able to.

If you're trying to scale agents to access all of your production services, data, etc, you need Executor as a unified management layer.

Hardware teams burn weeks on procurement. An engineer needs a part. Someone emails five distributors, chases quotes, gets an approval, wires the money, tracks a shipment across three carriers, clears customs, and then nobody knows where the box is or what's actually on the shelf.

Waybill runs that entire loop. Send us a part, a spec, or a BOM. We source it, pull quotes, route approvals, pay the supplier, handle freight and customs, track it to your dock, and keep your stock count updated. 

Take your supply chain for granted.

Built by a team that's seen it at LAT Aerospace and WareIQ (YC S20).

RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s.

In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week.

We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive.

What makes this possible is AI.

Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose.

Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient.

Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time.

Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible.

We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them.

Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie.

We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.

Marengo is the AI-native engineering firm automating engineering design, starting with data centers. We’ve generated $70K in revenue in our first month, with $4M in contracts to deliver.

Marengo is backed by YC, Exor, Future Planet Capital, undisclosed $2B AUM family office, and other top-tier investors.

Our team includes the former President & CEO of Saipem America ($3B+ P&L), former President of Exyte's Advanced Technology Facilities GBU ($6B+ P&L) and more.

The Lumoscope is a multispectral camera that clips onto your phone and scans your skin at home with the same light used in clinics. You see what a mirror can't: a breakout days before it surfaces, and wrinkles changing over time. Our software then reads that history, connects flare-ups to causes you'd never suspect, and matches products to what your own data shows works.

Markov is the data lab for engineering and computer-use AI. We capture real work from domain experts and craft high-fidelity datasets and RL environments.

We built the most complex tasks and RL environments sourced through manufacturing experts proficient in AutoCAD, SOLIDWORKS, CATIA, Revit, Siemens NX and more. Our computer-use datasets are action-labelled, narrated and sourced from domain experts in design and enterprise software.

We work with frontier AI labs and we've built over 10,000 CAD environments and collected over 500,000 hours of computer-use data. Our open-source datasets have 800,000+ downloads on Hugging Face.

Our mission is to build a city on Mars. 

Cosmic-1, the first equipment in our fleet, is an autonomous robot capable of heavy-lift manipulation. Its been deployed on some of the largest solar farms in the US, more than doubling labor productivity across tens of thousands of panel installs. 

We're scaling in solar, expanding in data centers, and building lunar construction robotics under contract with NASA.

Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility.

On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.

Give your agents a computer to run on, with their own email, phone, iMessage, and WhatsApp. Each agent runs next to its communication channels, so it never misses a reply, and sleeps when idle, so customers don’t pay for downtime.

​Gamgee began with Rosie, founder Paul Conyngham’s dog. After surgery, chemotherapy and immunotherapy failed, Rosie was given months to live. Paul used AI and genomic analysis to identify targets in her tumour, then worked with scientists at UNSW to produce what is believed to be the first fully computationally designed mRNA cancer vaccine delivered to a dog. Following treatment, several tumours shrank significantly and her quality of life improved

Gamgee is building an end to end platform for personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs. We sequence a dog’s tumour and healthy DNA, identify mutations unique to its cancer, and design a vaccine that teaches the immune system what to attack. We manage the entire process- from vet intake and tissue collection through genomic analysis, vaccine production, treatment and response monitoring

​We are now turning that one off effort into a repeatable clinical system. Gamgee is running clinical trials in Australia, working with vets, oncologists and specialised laboratories, and accepting cases globally. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next

ProvenMetal manufactures the fastest circuit boards in the United States.

Domestic circuit board manufacturing is slow and expensive, and while reshoring is happening, the supply chain isn't there yet.

We automate the bottlenecks - part procurement, DFM review, and assembly - delivering circuit boards in days instead of weeks.
Agentcard let's companies buy anything online. We work with companies building personal assistants to enable payments.

Agnost AI monitors AI agents in production: chat agents, voice agents, copilots and MCP servers.

It reads every conversation and OpenTelemetry trace, groups them by user and session, and catches what dashboards miss: wrong answers that look like success, frustrated users, broken tool calls.

Teams write evals/checks in plain language; Agnost judges every production conversation and alerts in Slack. When something fails, Auto Improve opens a pull request with a fix tested against past runs. Works with all agents framework.

For high-volume workflows, we also fine-tune specialized models on a customer's own traces.

Radley is the first AI-native radiology practice. We're acquiring a radiology practice bringing Radley to $4.6M in annualized revenue and rebuilding it with agents from the ground up.

Radiology is already in crisis: there aren't enough radiologists to interpret 1 in 6 medical scans. In 10 years, that gap is growing to 1 in 3 - 246M scans a year.

From past experience, we know that point solutions won’t cut it. While there is demand (we have $2.2M in contracts to prove it), bottleneck isn't just software, it's outdated systems and slow, inefficient operations. That's why we own the full stack, clinical and operational, end to end.

We met at Carbon Health as we scaled operations 31x and expanded to 100+ clinics. Now we're rebuilding radiology.
Care GP is building AI agents to run operations for primary healthcare clinics

Praxis captures the data physical AI is bottlenecked on: egocentric video, 3D scans, and multimodal capture from inside real industrial and residential environments. Embedded within publicly listed and unicorn-scale conglomerates, we reach 60k workers across 5 continents and 150+ environment types, supplying the real-world training data frontier labs and humanoid companies can't source anywhere else.
Levocred AI build AI employees for lenders including credit funds, fintechs, credit unions & banks to automate operations like servicing/collections, underwriting, back-office tasks etc.

Autonomous software for hotels that takes over all front-of-house and back-of-house tasks with zero integrations, running operations better than your staff would. Axelrod is trusted by Michelin Key awarded and Marriott hotels and is live across 3 continents.

CarSignal is the AI-native operating system for independent auto repair shops.

Most shops still run each repair across disconnected management software, scan tools, parts catalogs, service information, texts, spreadsheets, and knowledge kept in technicians’ heads. That fragmentation slows diagnosis, creates duplicate processes, and leaves customers waiting.

CarSignal connects the full repair process in one system. AI agents research vehicle-specific failure patterns and surface the tests that confirm or rule out each cause. The same system carries each job from booking and intake through inspections, estimates, parts, approvals, payment, and follow-up, so technicians spend less time searching and updating systems and more time fixing cars.

An agent’s access should depend on the task it is doing. The same action can be appropriate for one task and wrong for another. Access decisions need to adapt in real time as the agent works, but companies can’t turn every business judgment into a fixed rules or have people manually approve every step.

We train small, company-specific models that approve AI actions in real time. They consider the company’s policies and interests, the agent’s current task, and its past actions to decide whether each proposed action should be allowed. Access is specific to the task at hand and reassessed as the agent works.

Companies will rent intelligence from AI labs or run open-source models to power their agents. They’ll own the models that keep their entire AI workforce acting in their interests. Decawork is building those models.

Led by former institutional proxy voters and technologists with a collective 20+ years of experience, Pennant gives institutional investors, public companies, and corporate advisors voting and governance intelligence to act on their own principles at scale.

Derya deploys supply chain automations for startups, SMEs, and enterprises that fulfil their entire supply chain function, from prospecting and procurement to distribution of goods.

Our mission is to rebuild the supply chain from the ground up, turning one of the world’s hardest coordination problems into an AI native system that moves commodities by being integrated into both the supply chain infrastructure and the customer. We work across robotics, commodities, and food & beverages companies; procuring goods and managing various operation functions for them.

Tokenless is an applied AI research lab. Our goal is to end reward hacking. We do research and build tools to detect issues with environments and evals, understand model behavior in those environments, and prevent those issues from happening. Correcting them makes training more effective, makes model performance easier to interpret, and is crucial to solving the AI alignment problem.

If you’re training models with RL, building environments, or running agent evals, and want more confidence in your environments, we're here to help.

AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. 

Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs. All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex.

Mireye is building the infrastructure that powers agents to make decisions and act in the real world. One API and MCP to connect agents to the physical world with accurate data enrichment, signals and tools.

Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

We deploy robots that learn new tasks from a single human demonstration in the factory. We're starting in contract manufacturing, where lines change every week and both traditional automation and today's VLAs fall over.

Our founding team has 20+ years of experience in robotics. Navid was part of the core team that productized Spot at Boston Dynamics and led manipulation projects there. Before that, he was at Rethink Robotics. Mojtaba led whole-body control and manipulation efforts at Amazon Robotics and was a Research Assistant Professor at Northwestern University.

Lamb Labs is building Model Processing Units (MPUs), custom AI chips that hardcode LLM weights directly into silicon. Rather than adapting general-purpose processors to run AI models, we're rethinking how LLMs are implemented in hardware to make inference dramatically faster and more energy-efficient.

Your government sales team, powered by AI.

We pair AI-native software with hands-on expertise to help you build relationships, pursue the right opportunities, and deliver stronger proposals. Choose our managed services or put our SaaS platform to work with your own team.
83 Sciences uses AI to mine discarded experimental data and drive scientific breakthroughs. Working alongside labs, we discover the materials that will power the new Industrial Revolution.

Hubble’s mission is to unify the patient medical record and remove the barriers to accessing it. Today, a person’s health history is scattered across disconnected systems, leaving patients and the people helping them to piece it together. We’re building a future where one authorization unlocks a more complete record, regardless of where someone received care.

Our founders previously built healthcare and AI products at Grow Therapy and Amazon One Medical, and we’re backed by Y Combinator, Madrona, and Basis Set. We’re building our team in Seattle, with the opportunity to work directly with the founders and shape how people access and use their health information.

Skymerse is building one AI system for airline flight operations: from planning and monitoring in the operations center to real-time support in the cockpit. It is developing specialized aeronautical models that understand the data, constraints, and procedures behind each flight, replacing fragmented tools and manual interpretation. Notamify, its first product, already serves airline customers and thousands pilots and aviation professionals.

Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipulation layer for trash in general, making waste processing and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.

With tools like Cursor and Claude Code, writing software is no longer the bottleneck. Debugging is. Agents cannot fix production crashes using logs and traces that were sized for human eyeballs. The gap is missing data.

HyperProbe allows agents to debug live software autonomously. Our SDK drops non-breaking probes straight into running services to read exact variable states from memory at the moment of failure, instead of reasoning backwards from flat logs.

Zero redeploys. Under 1% CPU overhead. Automatic PII redaction.

We turn 4-hour production war rooms into 10-minute automated resolutions. As agents write and operate more of the world's software, HyperProbe is the runtime observability layer that lets them understand what they built.

TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage.

With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.

Verdict Machine uses AI to understand each financial institution's complete on-chain environment, assess its cyber risk and generate tailored controls. The same live model powers transaction prevention, continuous cyber diligence, security posture and cost-efficient wallet screening. Before execution, Verdict Machine evaluates proposed transactions against the institution's active policies.

In our first weeks, we started POCs with asset managers and digital-asset infrastructure providers whose systems move billions of dollars every week for financial institutions. We're now in active evaluations with digital-asset teams at some of the world's largest banks.

The founding team launched and led blockchain security at Check Point (NASDAQ: CHKP).
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel

description:
Anywhere is a personal, social map that brings your places, friends, plans, memories, and AI agents together. It gives you one place to discover where to go, organize the places you care about, and remember where you’ve been.

Built by the team behind Zenly, Bump & Life360.

Limnion is building an open-standards telemetry storage platform for observability at scale, including agentic workflows. Siglake is the open-source project that sits at the heart of it, designed around OTel, Parquet, and Iceberg. No proprietary storage, no vendor lock-in.

Dock is where you hire AI agents for business. Bring an idea, and your agents turn it into a company that runs: they find the customers, do the work and keep it moving, day and night. Building a company used to mean hiring a building full of people first. With Dock, entrepreneurs can start a real business today and run it like a company of a hundred. You decide where it goes. Your agents make it happen.
Distributed, hardware-agnostic AI inference

Speed is the moat. Our auto-research agents continuously optimize and iterate on the inference stack to push the limits of speed and cost efficiency, tuned for our customer workloads and hardware. We serve 4x faster open models than other providers in prod crossing 1200 tokens/sec and sub-500ms latency. 

Want ultra fast inference API or 4x more performance out of your existing hardware? Reach out to founders@isoquant.ai or book a time https://isoquant.ai/contact

Hop Aero is building rocket cargo vehicles that deliver to contested environments hundreds of miles away in minutes. Our rockets fly point-to-point into the most austere locations at hypersonic speeds. Hop Aero's goal is to provide the U.S. and allies the asymmetric advantage that deters a future major conflict.

PRINCEPS is the first purpose-built insurance company for the trillion-dollar compute buildout. We underwrite SLA, GPU residual value, and outage risk, and price the coverage that unlocks cheaper financing for data centers and neoclouds.
Hebbian Robotics builds open source foundational infrastructure for Physical AI to develop robots that extend what humanity can do, for the benefit of the communities they serve.

Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems.

Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments.

Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.

Florin is a full-stack insurance carrier where a model does the underwriting. When a submission comes in, Florin reads the ACORD forms, then investigates the risk on its own: satellite imagery, permits, public records, even the insured's Instagram, and catches exposures that never make it onto the application. It then simulates tens of thousands of ways the policy year could go, prices the risk, and returns a bindable quote in under a minute instead of weeks. The team is ex-Google, Tesla, Amazon, and Terrafirma, and the bet is that a carrier built this way wins on loss ratio, speed, and cost at the same time.

Locke is the first AI-native government affairs firm.

We pair elite lobbyists and political talent with our own AI systems, helping companies lobby policymakers and win government contracts.

Locke's team comes from The White House, Congress, and the Pentagon.
Petrarch works with bankruptcy courts to source records from enterprises in the critical infrastructure sectors, then rigorously de-identifies and transforms the data into RL environments and tasks.

SpaceFlow is an AI-native procurement services company for businesses that make, move and serve physical goods. We help procurement teams bring more spend under management, execute source-to-contract work and turn identified savings into realized savings without adding headcount or replacing existing systems.

Ethos makes silicon on the Moon to power terawatt scale data centers. The Moon's surface is 21% silicon. We melt and electrolyze the lunar surface to make raw materials for solar panels. With solar panels made from the Moon, the constraint that limits data center scaling and everything else in space is gone.

We build centimeter-accurate 3D maps of underground utilities to help construction contractors dig safer and faster. With underground intelligence, contractors can avoid dangerous utility strikes and costly project delays.

Avoca is the AI patient access platform built for radiology. It integrates with a network’s existing systems and operational knowledge to automate calls, online scheduling, faxes, e-referrals and patient communications, from referral through to results and follow-up. Unlike generic scheduling tools, Avoca understands the clinical, operational and resource constraints behind every radiology booking, helping providers capture more demand, reduce administrative work and fill more scan capacity.

Tracer is an AI research lab building more capable and efficient AI through model coordination. We research adaptive inference, ensembling, and systems in which multiple open-source models work together to produce capabilities beyond any single model.

Our work spans reasoning, code, research, and agentic systems, with the goal of making advanced intelligence more accessible and economical.

Wondering turns anything you want to learn, from LLMs to quantum mechanics to product design, into a path of three-minute lessons with visuals, podcasts, and interactive exercises. 

Each learning path and its content are personalized to your background, how you learn best, and how deep you want to go.

It’s the most delightful way to understand complex topics and turn information into knowledge you can remember and apply. You don’t just passively read. You practice, make connections, and form your own insights.

Start learning anything for free at https://wondering.app/download
AI that helps utilities buy power.

We make mass-deployable radars for unmanned systems. Our first product is Archimedes, a radar seeker that finds and locks onto targets, enabling autonomous intercept on any drone. We have over $580M in LOIs for Archimedes, across some of the largest defense primes in Ukraine, the EU, and the Middle East.

Seekers are the most critical and costly component in every autonomous interceptor. Developing a radar seeker takes a 200+ person team at Raytheon and hundreds of millions of dollars. Archimedes is 100x cheaper than existing radar seekers on the market - and is the first product to make it feasible to deploy radars on every drone.

OneCLI (YC S26) is an open-source platform for delegating business-critical work to AI agents, from Salesforce updates to data analysis and engineering investigations.

Agents work across your company’s apps, prepare changes, and pause for approval when your rules require it. Your team controls what they can access and change, while credentials stay out of the agents’ reach and every call is logged.

https://www.onecli.sh
location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel

description: We build and deploy AI agents that manage prospecting, qualification, CRM hygiene, forecasting, lead routing, revenue recovery, and all the complex revenue work in between, on autopilot.

Dawn Industries enables artificial intelligence to design, build, and program factory automation. Our robots create real things in the real world. Together we are building the next generation of American industry for all.
RL post-training for science reasoning and performance engineering

Autoresearch helps teams train agents for tasks where general models are not good enough. Give us a task, your current agent or model, and an evaluation. Autoresearch runs an autoresearch campaign across data, SFT and other post-training methods, continual learning, prompts, tools, harnesses, and systems, then returns the best verified improvement. It runs hosted or in your cloud.

We provide the research system around models: persistent memory, full experiment lineage, compute orchestration, and statistical verification. We’re starting with agent and model training, continual learning, and optimization.

Reach out to us for early access at founders@autoresearch.inc.

Robocurve builds open-source tools and independent benchmarks to measure how well robots can do real-world jobs. Instead of relying on unverified demo videos from frontier labs, we score their models on reproducible benchmarks that anyone can trust.

Today there are no well-run, standardized robotics benchmarks. Labs evaluate in-house, and no independent group has stepped in to run continuous benchmarking as a service. The result is that no one actually knows how good anyone else is, or where the real frontier sits.

Good benchmarks require operating and maintaining physical hardware and real-world setups. Simulation only goes so far, since models that look strong in sim can show large performance gaps once deployed in the real world. Building real-world benchmarks means coordinating job-domain experts, evals engineering, and hands-on robotics all at once.

Frontier labs are targeting general-purpose robotics by 2028, yet the field of robotics evals barely exists. Whoever builds the trusted measure of robot capability becomes the reference everyone relies on. We combine backgrounds in AI evals and robotics to build and grow this field as fast as possible. Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin.

Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running.

We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production.

As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.

Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across every project — so you look only when an agent needs you. Every client is just a view: the bundled terminal UI, SSH from another machine, your phone. Close one, open another; the work never stops.

Software can drive it too: a CLI, a socket API, and a plugin marketplace that passed 500 community plugins in its first month. The runtime is Apache-2.0 and stays open. Four months after launch: 25k GitHub stars, 340k downloads.

ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. The world generates petabytes of video every day, and almost none of it is readable to machines.  Frontier VLMs that can unlock this (like Gemini) are too expensive to run at the volume real industries have, too generic for any single task, and can't be deployed on-prem where sensitive video lives.

We are building an auto vision factory: take video plus a customer's objective, distill a frontier model, and post-train a small open model that is SOTA on that one task and serve it blazingly fast. Reific builds RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time, for the frontier labs that train agents. AI has learned to reason over text and code. But most of what matters in the real world shows up as numbers that change every second: a heartbeat, a gearbox, a GPU cluster. No human can track thousands of signals at once, but AI should be able to.

In our environments, data streams in on a clock while the agent works, and every action is graded by what actually happened. Most AI training today teaches models to match human experts. We treat human performance as the floor. Each environment comes from real, de-identified records, in three task families: personal agents, industry, and science & compute.

Today, even the best frontier model averages under 50% on each family. Training an open model on our environments raised its full-solve rate on unseen tasks by 54% (from 25.6% to 39.5%), with no loss on general benchmarks. Our mission is to build the infrastructure that keeps AI climbing the frontier, long past human level in the real world.

Alzheimer's testing today is bottlenecked around the onset of symptoms, when the damage is already done. Current treatments, including the FDA-approved drugs released in 2024, don't reverse the disease; they only slow it down. Earlier detection means earlier intervention.

Eye movement changes linked to Alzheimer's surface sooner than any other biomarker, up to 15 years before symptoms appear.

We deliver a 15-minute VR assessment delivered to patients in longevity clinics:
• Tasks: patients perform visual tasks designed by neurologists to trigger a distinct oculomotor response in people with Alzheimer's or on its path
• Hardware: our patent-pending attachment connects to any VR headset on the market and captures these eye movement patterns.
• Analysis: the patterns are compared against our ML model to produce a risk analysis.

Once classified, patients can access new interventions, such as the FDA-approved drugs. They're also referred to longevity practices, neurology practices or both, depending on their stage of decline.

Testing for the earliest biomarkers allows the earliest possible intervention. In some cases, that slows the disease enough that patients outlive the onset of symptoms and never face memory loss in their lifetime.

Agent 37 builds the cheapest sandboxes for running AI agents.

Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline.

Orgo is the simplest way to give your AI employees their own secure, persistent cloud computers. Over 1000 teams use Orgo to run AI workers.

**Problem**

Humans used to need laptops to do their work. Now they prompt agents instead, and those agents need computers too: always-on, in large quantities, and with unlimited capabilities. 

Building and maintaining that yourself is far from trivial.

**Solution**

Boat provides powerful, simple, permissive Ubuntu VMs in the cloud. In a sandbox, an agent can work for long periods on code or on knowledge work like legal, research, reporting, and auditing.

**Why Boat and not any other cloud VM?**

1. It is ready out of the box: every sandbox ships with a desktop, chrome, languages, docker, snapshots, and templates, plus a CLI, SDK, API, and control pane for your fleet.
2. It is permissive and paradigm agnostic: any number of agents can use any number of sandboxes. Agents can run inside or use sandboxes as an external tool.
3. It is expertly crafted: we manage everything from the individual CPU to the orchestration software, which makes sandboxes stable, persistent, scalable, and secure.
4. It is the best performance and price in town: our CPUs rank first on HPC benchmarks, and sandboxes are typically 9x to 18x cheaper than other leading sandboxes.

**Further notes**

Sandboxes are hosted in Europe, which keeps prices low, and more regions are coming. Unless compliance requires it, agents don't notice the region they run in.

Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions.

That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers. 

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot.

Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on. And to the Health Insurers' "Delay, Deny, Defend", we say "Predict, Prevent, Prevail".

Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI systems faster and keep them secure in production.

Mirrors gives developers the infrastructure to control what production AI agents are told, and when. OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other’s histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. It’s open source and self-hostable. Companies get 100M tokens of session data ingested free per month, no credit card required.

Perceptual Labs is an applied neolab focused on weight-space programming and alignment research. Our ambition is to fundamentally change how we build, serve, and shape intelligence: shifting from training models to engineering intelligence through precise neuron editing.

River lets you work with AI across your apps, browser, files, and phone. Give it a project, like planning a team onsite, and it can research venues, build a budget, and put together the schedule using your tools and context. Superserve gives every AI agent its own computer in the cloud. Each one is an isolated VM that starts in under 50ms, sleeps between turns, and picks up exactly where it left off, for hours, weeks or indefinitely.

Traditional cloud infrastructure was built to run one app for many users. Agents flip that. Each agent needs its own isolated machine where it can write and run code, use tools and work on its own for long stretches. Everything it produces has to persist the whole time, the way your laptop keeps your work.

That means agent computers have to be stateful, secure and cheap to run. For agents that talk to customers, they also have to start, sleep and wake almost instantly.

Fast - Machines start in under 50ms, either cold or from a template with your repo and dependencies already loaded. You don't need to keep a pool of servers running and waiting.

Persistent - Paused machines keep their full memory and disk state at zero compute cost. They can resume or fork from that exact state. Pausing and resuming is fast enough that a machine can sleep between inference calls and wake on the next turn. Agents can run Docker, databases, browsers or any other service inside.

Secure - Every machine is a microVM with its own kernel. You can program the rules for what traffic can come in and go out, and they're enforced at the network boundary where the agent can't reach them. API secrets are handled at the network layer too, so they never enter the machine. Every action is logged for audits.

Teams building coding agents, autonomous workers, and eval or RL training environments use Superserve to give every agent session or rollout its own machine, with no infrastructure to manage.

We run 100K+ machines every week for teams including Lindy and Y Combinator.

Tilo gives AI agents one shared computer. Today every agent gets its own virtual machine and works by screenshots and clicks, which is slow, expensive and brittle. Agents that work together have to describe what they did to each other in messages.

FlashDrive is a shared drive for teams and their AI agents. You can use it via MCP or mount it like a normal folder on macOS and Linux, so your laptop, your teammates' and every sandbox work in the same live files at once. Agents hand off work through files: one writes, the next one reads.

That makes AI multiplayer across a whole company. Everyone keeps the agent they already like, whether that's Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or something custom, and there's no new app to learn. Your agents and your teammates' agents work in the same files and pick up where each other left off.

Shared drives were built for people. Agents work differently: many of them edit the same files at once. Unlike Dropbox or Google Drive, FlashDrive merges edits made at the same time, or keeps both, instead of creating a conflicted copy. Cloud sandboxes connect with no setup, huge files stream instead of filling the disk, and every file can be searched with keywords and grep.

Luminary is an AI CEO that leads human and agent teams on company-wide missions. We're building the complete infrastructure for a fully AI-native company, starting with a world model of how your business works and building up to an AI CEO that can lead it.

Someone has to decide what's worth building, rally the right people behind it, and bring it to market.

Luminary takes on that job. Instead of asking it to build a feature, you hand it part of your business to grow. It then proactively discovers opportunities, plans high-impact missions, and leads your people and its own agent swarms to accomplish them. 

Some examples of audacious missions it can execute:

- Launch a product: It spots customers building the same workaround, makes the business case, directs coding agents to build it, and rolls it out.
- Enter a new market: It finds an unexpected group of buyers, reworks positioning and pricing around them, and wins the first accounts.
- Rescue a stalled deal: It notices an enterprise deal losing momentum, designs a new strategy with your sales team, and gets it signed.

Under the hood, Luminary builds a living world model and follows a leadership constitution that shapes every call. Proprietary evals check every deliverable, and a recursive self-improvement loop turns each mission into institutional wisdom.
